PROBLEM. User-facing core text points users at contributor material or uses project-internal labels. Verified on origin/develop 07de4cd: `benchbox run --stats-reset` help says 'default PR #980 behavior' (benchbox/cli/commands/run.py:2627); TPCHStreamRunner exception cites `adr-concurrency-public-api-reconciliation` (benchbox/core/tpch/streams.py:294); capability_registry.py:125 cites ADR-3 in user text; ClickHouse compat rule reason says 'recorded only in the PR #3578 description' (benchbox/sql_compat/rules/query_adapter/clickhouse_session_policy.py:25; rule reasons are exported to the public docs-data bundle, scripts/export_docs_data.py:184); `benchbox submit` help uses project phase labels ('Phase 2/3 mode', submit.py:524-615); platform.py:872-876 help explains maintainer history; README.md:231-232 links users to docs/internal/release-guide.md (never published); examples/tunings/README.md:227 tells users to run `_project/scripts/...`; examples/unified_runner.py:408,744 writes to `_project/runner_results` by default. The salt refusal's ADR link is fixed by public-pseudonym-salt-automatic (#3878).
CHANGE. Reword each in user terms (keep the actionable replacement API/behaviour; README links published release/compatibility material only; examples default to a user output dir such as the BenchBox runtime results dir). Guard: extend the EXISTING tests/unit/cli/test_shipped_docs_urls.py (already scans benchbox text, README, CONTRIBUTING, examples against quality/docs-ownership.json) with contributor-reference patterns: `adr-<slug>`, `ADR-<n>`, `/adr/`, `PR #<n>`, `docs/internal/`, `docs/agent/`, `_project/`; allowlist data values that are not prose (e.g. TUNING_POLICY_GENERATION = 'adr-003-spark-baseline' in policy_generation.py:7, written into results) in an inline frozenset like the file's `_ALLOWED_HOSTS`; maintainer-only modules (sql_compat baseline_tool/inventory default paths) excluded by the same mechanism. Make README-only changes run this test in CI (.github/ci-units.yml mapping, or content-guard). changelog.d fragment (fix).
